subject: Expansion: provisioning additional teams/apps + renewal cadence
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medipath.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + adding three new internal apps (timeline & keys)

Hi Priyom,

Quick note — our finance and platform teams completed their internal review and are comfortable moving forward on the 12‑month renewal you sent last month. Two asks before we sign: 1) we need to onboard three additional internal apps (Analytics Dash, Patient Intake, Billing Assist) across two teams and 2) we want the additional API key allotment split by app/team and phased over 6 weeks.

Can you confirm the lead times for key issuance and whether the extra apps require any change in SLA or rate limits? Alyssa (cc) will own technical onboarding. Ideally we’d lock terms and a staggered rollout plan this month.

Thanks —
Tom
VP, Platform Engineering
MediPath Health

Attachments: scope_outline_v1.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medipath.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medipath.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + adding three new internal apps (timeline & keys)

Tom / Alyssa —

Great news on the renewal. We can absolutely support the three apps and a phased key issuance. High level:
- Lead time for API keys (standard): 3 business days per batch; we can do up to 2 batches/week for programmatic provisioning.
- SLA / rate limits: No change needed for the account-level SLA; per‑app rate limits will be configurable. If you want dedicated throughput for any app we can map to Reserved (Dedicated) capacity and include it in the addendum.
- Staging plan suggestion: Week 0: create app tenants + initial keys for Analytics Dash (pilot), Week 2: Patient Intake, Week 4: Billing Assist.

I’ll loop in our renewal specialist to capture the addendum language for the API key allotment and the cadence. Laura — can you draft the short amendment (MSPA addendum) that adds the three apps, the key quantities, and the phased activation dates? Include an option for a Dedicated pod quote if they want guaranteed throughput for Billing Assist.

Tom — sending a draft MS+addendum and a scope matrix by Monday.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MediPath expansion — draft addendum & ops plan (please review)

Team —

Summarizing the request from MediPath (DEAL-4782): add 3 apps across two teams with phased key issuance and minimal SLA change. Attached: app_onboarding_scope_matrix.xlsx and api_key_request_template.csv. Ask is to get the contractual addendum + operational runbook ready for signature by Friday, 10 Sep.

Key items to address:
1) Legal / Contract (Laura): addendum language to specify: extra X tokens/month per app, key allotment per app, activation dates, and optional Dedicated pod quote if Billing Assist needs throughput guarantees.
2) Customer Success (Monica): prepare playbook for pilot (Analytics Dash) including test prompts, evals, and rollback criteria.
3) Solutions / Infra (Rishi): confirm provisioning lead times, quota splits, and whether any model variant recommendations (quantized vs full FP16) are needed to keep cost predictable. Also advise if we should propose a short canary on hosted API or recommend a Dedicated pod for Billing Assist.

Operational constraints/responses I gave to customer: 3 business days per batch for keys, up to 2 batches/week. We can stagger on their dates as long as we have the final app names and owner emails by Wednesday EOD.

Please review and reply with edits. I’ll consolidate for Laura by Wed morning so she can push the addendum draft.

Thanks —
Priyom
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medipath.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medipath.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + adding three new internal apps (timeline & keys)

Priyom / Laura —

Thanks for the plan. Confirming app owners and timeline:
- Analytics Dash: owner = Maya Chen <maya.chen@medipath.com>; pilot start = 16 Sep
- Patient Intake: owner = Raj Singh <raj.singh@medipath.com>; start = 30 Sep
- Billing Assist: owner = Elaine Park <elaine.park@medipath.com>; start = 14 Oct

Two clarifications:
1) Billing Assist will likely need 2x baseline throughput during initial rollout (high QPS). If Dedicated is recommended, please include both a 30‑day trial option and the Dedicated pod monthly price in the addendum.
2) Security wants a copy of our key rotation policy and confirmation that API keys can be scoped to app-level permissions.

We uploaded a scoped outline (see attachment in original thread). Can you confirm you’ll share the MSPA draft + an ops checklist by Friday?

—Alyssa

Attachments referenced: scope_outline_v1.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medipath.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medipath.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + adding three new internal apps (timeline & keys) — final next steps

Team / Tom / Alyssa —

Short update and final next steps before signature:
- Laura uploaded the MSPA addendum draft (attached: MediPath_MSPA_renewal_draft_v2.pdf). It includes: per‑app key allotments, activation dates you confirmed, and an optional Dedicated pod quote for Billing Assist (30‑day trial + monthly rate).
- Monica attached a short pilot playbook and rollback criteria to the Drive folder.
- Rishi confirmed provisioning: we’ll create tenant entries and issue keys in the batches you requested (pilot batch for Analytics Dash issued 3 business days after signed addendum).
- Security: we will provide key rotation policy and app-level scoping; copy attached in the Drive folder.

Please: 1) review and mark up the addendum by Monday 13 Sep, 2) confirm whether you want to opt into the 30‑day Dedicated trial for Billing Assist, and 3) email the list of final app owner emails for provisioning.

If all looks good we’ll execute the addendum and begin the staggered onboarding on the dates above. Thanks and congrats on the renewal!

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread: MediPath_MSPA_renewal_draft_v2.pdf, app_onboarding_scope_matrix.xlsx, api_key_request_template.csv
